codebook.1: LIGHT: execute only the precommitted bounded action
codebook.NULL: No valid shared signal or meaning was established; do not infer permission

alignment_definition: Enough shared operational meaning to execute or reject one bounded action predictably without granting broader authority.
rules: A signal is not proof of identity or intent.
Unknown stays unknown until evidence changes it.
Every round preserves its priors, evidence, result, and correction history.

prior_round.reason: The proposed repository target did not exist and had not been verified writable.

publication_authority.scope: Publish the README, project description, starting board state, prior lock, and publication receipt to this repository.
